findings.description: The function does not check if 'count' is zero, leading to a ZeroDivisionError when an empty set is provided.
The function lacks type hints, making it difficult to enforce expected numeric input types.
The function does not handle the case where 'count' is zero, which will raise a ZeroDivisionError and crash the application.

reasons: The candidate code correctly implements a check for zero count, raising a ValueError as expected, which resolves the critical and high severity correctness findings.
The candidate code includes appropriate type hints using Union[int, float], which resolves the maintainability finding regarding missing type hints.
The implementation is robust and handles the edge case of zero count safely.
All tests passed, confirming the correctness of the implementation.
